text: ООО «Синергетик», the Russian company whose website is synergetic.ru, has had Planet Synergetic C Limited (Mauritius, registration number 216186) as its participant since 18 March 2025, holding 100% of its capital.
short: Planet Synergetic C Limited (Mauritius) owns 100% of ООО «Синергетик»

source.name: Checko: ООО "СИНЕРГЕТИК" (EGRUL data), company page
source.quote: ПЛАНЕТА СИНЕРГЕТИК СИ ЛИМИТЕД Маврикий Регистрационный номер 216186 с 18 марта 2025 г. 16,3 тыс. руб. 100%
source.note: Founders-table row of the Checko page: ПЛАНЕТА СИНЕРГЕТИК СИ ЛИМИТЕД (Mauritius, registration number 216186) has been the participant since 18 March 2025, with 'Доля капитала' 100% (16,3 тыс. руб.). The same page lists synergetic.ru among the company's websites. Page data is from the EGRUL and updated daily; the date given is the date the page was opened.
